source.title: Seasonality in the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
source.mechanism_evidence: The paper defines SEAS as the mean return on the same weekday over the previous 20 weeks and reports positive cross-sectional return predictability; robustness includes alternative formation windows.

research_question: Do cryptocurrencies with high average returns on the same weekday over the prior 20 weeks continue to outperform low-SEAS cryptocurrencies in a point-in-time liquid Binance USD-M perpetual universe after realistic turnover costs?
hypothesis: Recurring weekday-specific investor demand, capital flows, and trading routines create asset-specific seasonal return patterns that persist cross-sectionally.
data: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals, 1h OHLCV aggregated to complete UTC days.
feature_definition: SEAS_t = mean of each asset's completed daily close-to-close returns on the same UTC weekday at t-7, t-14, ..., t-7W; current-day return is excluded.
universe_rule: At each UTC day open, require complete formation history and 30 prior complete UTC days of quote volume; rank contemporaneously eligible contracts by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume and keep the top 50. No asset is selected using future or strategy returns.
portfolio: Daily dollar-neutral equal-weight long top SEAS quintile and short bottom SEAS quintile, 1.0 gross exposure (0.5 long, 0.5 short).
execution: Signal is determined before the UTC day open from completed prior data; trade at the current day open and mark return to the next UTC day open. Costs are charged on actual portfolio turnover.
diagnostic_gate: Canonical development mean daily Spearman rank IC >= 0.02, HAC/Newey-West p < 0.05, and mean high-minus-low raw return > 0.
development_gate: Diagnostic gate passes; canonical net Sharpe > 0.70; canonical total return > 0; both 2022 and 2023 non-negative; at least 2 of 3 preregistered formation windows have positive net total return.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe > 1.0; canonical OOS mean rank IC >= 0.02; positive total return at 2x costs; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown > -35%; at least 2 of 3 formation windows positive; top-30 stricter-liquidity universe positive; excluding BTC/ETH positive; excluding strongest contributor positive; family DSR >= 0.95; global-trial-count proxy DSR >= 0.95.
kill_criteria: Fail the preregistered development gate => REJECT without consuming exploratory OOS. Any unresolved leakage or SUCCESS GATE failure after OOS => REJECT.
